subject.title: refactor(cli): consolidate capability and command regression suites

question: Should this protected maintainer-labelled test-suite consolidation be rebased or refreshed and then landed as the canonical CLI regression cleanup?
rationale: The patch is intentionally broad across four security- and provider-adjacent CLI test suites, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer ownership even though no line-level defect is currently established.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, confirm the cited targeted regression coverage remains intact, then merge the test-only refactor.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Split out any helper that makes a fail-closed assertion less locally legible before merging the remaining consolidation.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, confirm the cited targeted regression coverage remains intact, then merge the test-only refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: The current contributor supplied the implementation, validation comparison, and dependency-contract context for these exact CLI suites.
